exposure: Intracavitary electrocardiography (IC-ECG) for tip location of ultrasound-guided centrally inserted central venous catheters (CICCs)
cohort: The study included 105 neonates requiring insertion of ultrasound-guided centrally inserted central venous catheters (CICCs) with a caliber of 3Fr or more.
finding: When applied to ultrasound guided CICCs in neonates, IC-ECG for tip location was found to be 100% applicable, 100% feasible, 100% accurate, and safe with no adverse events.
